players.product: Hyperscale AI data-center campus with behind-the-meter power (Project Matador, Texas): powered land, powered shell and turnkey data centers leased to AI compute tenants (first tenant TensorWave, 222 MW initial phase)

quarterly_data.signal: Fermi's July 15, 2026 release (8-K exhibit) states it has invested more than $1.4 billion in Project Matador site buildout to date, and that, subject to entering into binding tenant agreements, the project is expected to ramp to approximately 1.5 gigawatts through 2027, with capital deployment matched to commercial progress. The release lists signing binding tenant agreements, advancing strategic partnerships and delivering initial power at the site as the company's near-term business objectives.
quarterly_data.figure: more than $1.4 billion invested in site buildout; approximately 1.5 gigawatts through 2027 (subject to binding tenant agreements)
